issues.description: The problem statement and the template expect Developer.init to accept two parameters (name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?). In the solution, Developer.init is implemented with an extra parameter (age: Int), but the solution's Client still calls the initializer with only two arguments. This creates a mismatch between the specification/template and the solution, and an internal inconsistency in the solution code that will prevent compilation and confuse students who compare artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the unintended 'age' parameter from the Developer initializer in the solution so its signature is init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and matches the problem statement and template. Alternatively, if an age parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template to include it and update all instantiations (Client) accordingly; however the preferable fix is to align the solution with the original two-parameter specification.

issues.description: The Developer initializer signature is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement describes and the template expects an initializer that configures the two properties (name, monthsOfSwiftExperience). The solution repository implements a different initializer signature that includes an extra parameter named 'age' (init(name:monthsOfSwiftExperience:age:)). This mismatch (extra parameter name) breaks the direct mapping from the exercise requirements to the reference implementation and may confuse students about the expected initializer and how to instantiate Developer.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Developer initializer consistent with the problem statement and template by removing the extra 'age' parameter in the solution. Change the solution initializer to init(name: String, monthsOfSwiftExperience: Int?) and preserve the call to print(self.swiftExperienceDescription()). Alternatively, if 'age' is intended, update the problem statement and template (and client usage) to document and accept the age parameter so all artifacts match.
